description: Update an existing service (price, duration, status, etc.). Creates a price history entry if price changes. Delivery-verification overrides can be changed too: verificationLevel (none / default_confirm / dual_confirm / documented — see service_create for semantics) and qualityCapture (1–5 rating on confirmation). Pass null on either to reset that field and inherit the organization default again; omit to leave it unchanged.
name: service_update
